items.title: Automatic Digital Security Door Lock System
items.sub: B.Eng. thesis, Ahmadu Bello University. Supervisor: Dr. Adamu Sani. Control Lab, 2014 to 2016.
items.summary: PIC16F877A access control with a custom circuit and PCB.
items.flownote: Conceptual block diagram. The microcontroller and multi-user authentication come from the CV. Input and actuator hardware are not named there.
items.body:
## Problem
Mechanical locks give no control over who may enter and no record of access. This thesis builds an electronic lock that authenticates users before granting access.
## Objectives
- Implement multi-user authentication and access-control logic on a microcontroller.
- Design the electronic circuit and fabricate the printed circuit board.
- Document the design process, schematics and testing outcomes in a final report.
## Method
Several microcontroller architectures and programming languages were evaluated. The PIC16F877A was selected and programmed. The circuit was designed and the PCB fabricated for the final system.

items.title: Hybrid Physics-Informed ML for EV Energy Consumption
items.sub: M.Tech thesis, Vivekananda Global University. Supervisor: Dr. Mukesh Sharma. Simulation and Software Lab, Aug 2025 to Aug 2026.
items.summary: Newton-Euler dynamics with Random Forest and XGBoost residual correction.
items.body:
## Problem
Electric vehicle energy use changes with terrain, weather and other conditions. Physics-only models are interpretable but leave out effects they do not represent. Purely data-driven models can be hard to trust outside their training conditions. This thesis combines the two.
## Methodology
- A Newton-Euler vehicle dynamics model gives a physics-based energy estimate.
- Random Forest and XGBoost models learn a residual correction on top of that estimate.
- A 10,000-instance synthetic dataset, engineered across nine environmental and geographical features, supports controlled evaluation.
## Reported result
The CV reports a 98% RMSE reduction over the physics-only baseline. The dataset is synthetic, so this shows a controlled comparison, not real-world accuracy.

items.title: Telecom Power and Network Monitoring
items.sub: IHS Towers of Strength, Abuja. Network Surveillance Specialist (Sep 2022 to Nov 2024); Field Support Engineer (Mar 2018 to Aug 2022).
items.summary: Remote monitoring and field maintenance of network and power infrastructure.
items.flownote: Generic workflow. No company data, site identifiers or screenshots are shown.
items.body:
## Problem
Telecom sites need continuous power and healthy network equipment. Faults have to be caught early from alarms and electrical parameters, before they become outages.
## Work performed
- Continuous remote monitoring of network and power infrastructure with Huawei U2000, Huawei OWS/ICTOM, RMS and Affectli, identifying alarms and abnormal operating conditions.
- Monitoring voltage, current, temperature and equipment status for early fault detection and troubleshooting.
- Field maintenance and troubleshooting of AC/DC power systems, rectifiers, batteries, UPS, ATS, generators and hybrid/solar systems.
- Preventive and corrective maintenance with electrical measurements to find degradation before failure.
- Monitoring generator energy consumption, forecasting diesel needs and optimising refilling schedules.
